headline: Executive order from 1996 sets direction for how the National Wildlife Refuge System is managed and used by the public.
what_it_does: This order deals with how federal wildlife refuges are run and how the public may use them. Its title points to guidance for the agencies that manage these lands and for public activities on them. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and directions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order addresses how members of the public may use refuge lands.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage wildlife refuges
who_it_affects.how: The order gives direction on how the refuge system should be managed.
